Crank Sisters Social Ride

Roanoke, VA · Grandin Village · Road · Social

Women / trans / femmeNo-dropBeginner friendly

Crank Sisters Social Ride is a road and social group ride in Roanoke, VA. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Cardinal Bicycle Grandin Village. About 10 miles, casual, social. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual, social. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Crank Sisters Social Ride group ride

A casual ride for women, trans and non-binary riders. Ten flat miles on the Greenway and quiet neighborhood streets, with a detour to some rolling climbs if the group wants it. Snacks and drinks at the Cardinal Cafe after.
